# Recorded MCP tool results

`forge_fetch_wikipedia_mark_sutcliffe.json` is the exact text a Pergamon Forge
`fetch` MCP tool returned for <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Sutcliffe>
(first 12k-char chunk) in the paired cost benchmark of 2026-11-23. It pins the
result-normalization behaviour (`local_operator/tools/result_normalize.py`) to a
real payload shape. Content: Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0.
